names.avg3_170: Chico del Distrito de las Cenizas

steps: You stop wishing, and Hazana agrees to go home. Peace seems close—until fake Scepters of Death appear and the Senate retaliates. To end the chaos for good, you lead the New Star Guild into enemy territory...
==Off==Monolith Calendar Year 997, Trekker Association, Outside Emor
Thanks for your business. How's it treating you?
It's amazing!==B====W== Yesterday I stepped out of a Monolith and ran straight into a pack of bandits...
Normally I'd be helpless, at their mercy.==W== But the second I pulled out the Scepter of Death, they scattered before I could blink.==W==
If I had one complaint, it's the noise...==W== And you have to watch your ammo.==W== By the way, do you sell bullets separately?
We do! A box of fifty is fifty thousand Dorra.
Wait, seriously?==W== The Scepter was only a hundred thousand Dorra. Fifty bullets cost that much?
You've got it backwards, friend. The Scepter's real value is in the bullets.==W== Without ammo, it's nothing but an expensive club.
Fair point...==W== I'll take one hundred rounds.
One hundred rounds,==W== coming up!==W== Thanks for your business ♪
Yahaha! Five million Dorra today alone.==W== We cleared over a hundred million this week alone. We're on a roll!
Haha! Never thought we'd get this rich hunting the Salvation Committee.==W== Teaming up with the Boss was a good call.
Hazana, Myrsha.==W== We need to talk.
You saw the news. Angie's locked away for life, without parole. Heresy and attempted murder.
Now that Angie and the Salvation Committee are done, we should stop wishing for the Scepters.==W== They're too dangerous and unpredictable. For world peace. For Nova's safety.
I knew you'd bring this up the moment I heard Angie got busted.
But don't get me wrong. The Desert Scorpions couldn't care less about world peace or Nova's safety.
Sure, the Artifact is dangerous.==W== But is an attack from a Scepter of Death any different than an attack from magic?
If there's demand, we supply. We aren't forcing anyone to buy them, let alone use them on each other.
But we respect our friends.==W== You cranked out thousands of these things for us. You said your constitution was unique...
But it's clearly wearing you down...==W== Even if you get to keep your memories, you're physically drained.==W== We Scorpions don't put our friends through that.
That takes a huge weight off my shoulders.==W== Thanks. I appreciate it.
Don't get soft on me, Boss.==W== We know a good thing when we see it. Reliable, brilliant partners with actual miracle powers don't grow on trees.
I am selling off the rest of our stock, though.==W== No objections?
Right. Sitting on a stockpile like that paints a massive target on our backs. Best to clear it out.
And ... that means every Scepter we sell is one we can't replace. Perfect excuse to jack up the prices!==W== Hehe, wonder how much we'll rake in by the end! ♪
I'm heading back to Philae soon. What's next for you two?
The rest of the Desert Scorpions are still in Mirage. It's been a while, hasn't it?
Yeah. Time we headed back with our earnings.
With Boss Accord backing us, we're legit corporate folks! No more getting lowballed by the big guys.==W== Heading back to help build up our hometown sounds pretty good! ♪
Life without a Monolith is tough. Why not move to Philae? Or anywhere else?
Haha. Appreciate the offer, Boss,==W== but we're staying put. Doesn't matter how nice a place is. There's nowhere like home.
I think, I made the right call this time.
I never found the desert Monolith, and my true identity is still a mystery.
But after all I've been through, I picked up quite a few titles:

_NOT_IN_LOG_==A0.5====Off==CEO of Boss Accord major shareholder of United Harvest Philae protector of the White Cat Troupe lifetime honorary member of the Ashwind Clan a friend to Mirage factions and—a Trekker of the New Star Guild
I doubt there's anyone left on Nova who actually believes I'm the legendary Tyrant.

And if I keep going,==W== there's Chitose's ==SEX11==,==W== Fuyuka's Master,==W== Nazuka's absolute most important person (her exact words),==W== Otoha's partner in crime, and more.==B====W== No wonder Noya jokes every time I hop in Loxy:
This ride can't fit that many people!
Time passes.==W== The Desert Scorpions and the White Cat Troupe bury the hatchet==W== and start mining a new crystal diamond vein together.
United Harvest Philae helps the people of Mirage grow valuable desert crops and buys the harvest.==W== With everyone working together, the former Edge of the World is thriving.
Allie moves the Daisy Orphanage back to Mirage.==W== She says the kids from White Cat and the Scorpions prefer the open desert over the skyscrapers of Philae.
With Mirage's population booming, busy parents keep asking Allie to watch their kids.==W== The Daisy Orphanage has basically turned into a daycare.
As for me,==W== I'm buried under company paperwork. I had to rope Mistique into being my personal chauffeur, flying me back and forth between Emor, Philae, and Mirage.
It's been a while==W== since I traveled with the New Star Guild.
Hehe, welcome to the reality of running a business♪==W== Not that I've ever been a boss myself★==W== But hey, once you retire, you'll have all the free time in the world.
Stop zoning out and hold tight!==W== We're flying straight to Mirage! ★
Wait!==W== You can't just floor it from the start!==W== Waaaaaah—!
==Off==I thought this peaceful routine would go on forever.
==Off==But what I had done finally brought a storm.
W-What?==W== A Trekker from outside the desert shot up the Eureka Bar with a Scepter of Death? And Benito was hit?
Yeah... She got a scratch. Nothing serious.==W== We have the Trekker detained,==W== but we have no idea where that Scepter came from.
Wasn't it one of the ones we sold?
That's the weird part.==W== First of all, it looks completely different. It's weaker than ours, and it has this strange attachment on the barrel. Barely makes a sound when fired.
Boss, I just heard from Albedo. She wants us in Emor. Says it's urgent.
Leaving already, Boss?==W== Stay for dinner with the kids. They've been looking forward to it.
I'm sorry, Allie. Something urgent came up. I have to skip dinner.
If you can't stay, at least take some bread for the road.==W== You have to eat properly no matter how busy you are, you hear me?
I hear you.==W== Do me a favor and tell everyone at the New Star Guild I'll be back soon. Tell them not to worry.
But after hearing the truth from Albedo... I finally understood the gravity of the situation. It went far deeper than I imagined.
Yes. After you flooded the market with the Scepters of Death, the corporate Senators felt threatened. They immediately formed teams to crack the wishing prayers.
But the success rate of their reverse-engineered prayers was too low, and the toll on the wishers was too high. It never went anywhere.
Then, two months ago, the prison holding Angie was attacked. She escaped in the mass breakout. Since then, a mysterious group has appeared, flooding the black market with new Scepters.
You're saying...==W== Angie rebuilt the Salvation Committee, perfected the prayer, and made the wishes work?
There is more.==W== Willow, take it from here.

Dozens of guilds have gone dark recently. I suspect they were abducted and forced to make wishes. That only covers the ones we know about. We don't track guilds missing for under a month, so the actual number could be much bigger.
Even if you're looking our way, you won't find a thing. We don't touch jobs with zero payoff.
Yeah, this is on you for not watching your prisoners.
Hazana, Myrsha, drop it.==W== I'm the one who started the Scepter mess.==W== This one is on me.
We are not blaming anyone. On the contrary...==W== We invite Boss here today to entrust you with the investigation.
Naturally, Grace Imperium will back you fully.==W== Greyhorn?
She will lead her team in support, with all expenses covered by us.==W== If you need anything else, every resource Grace Imperium has is yours to command.
Greyhorn, are they at it again outside?
Yeah.==W== Two gangs are tearing up the streets with Scepters of Death. No one dares to step outside after dark anymore.
We need to hold out for three more days.==W== We've identified the corporate Senators funding the smuggling ring.==W== They're holding a gathering on Snowish Eve. We'll take them all down at once.
We also found a familiar name on the guest list.==W== Angie. We've been tracking her for a year, and she's going to be there.
Good work, Greyhorn.==W== Where are Hazana and Myrsha?
We fell for a decoy earlier. The Scorpions are split up between Port Goldfinch and Geminia.
Backup from the Dusk Arbiter and Sentinel of Dawn just left Emor. Neither squad will make it in time.
We're short-handed.==W== Can you call in the local Imperial Guard?
I'm sorry.==W== Our casualties this past year have been too severe... The Grand Captain ordered a full withdrawal from the operation.
The Imperial Guard is a company that puts Dorra first.==W== But there are things our knights care about more than money.
You've been crossing the continent to keep the peace.==W== Until every last criminal is brought to justice, I am personally at your command.
It's what the Guard was founded to do. And I need to atone for my mistakes.
Mistakes?==W== I didn't think a by-the-book knight like you ever messed up.
I did.==W== I followed the Grand Captain's orders and helped Angie hunt you down.
Watching you peddle Scepters of Death back then, I even suspected that you were really the legendary Tyrant. But...
Angie set me straight. She said I didn't understand you, or how this world would end.
At the time, her words made no sense to me.==W== But after working alongside you, I think I finally get it.
You and Angie are the same.==W== Both of you would risk everything for this world, for other people...
... and do things everyone else finds insane. Thankless. Even heretical.
The same, huh.==W== Maybe you're right. I'm doing exactly what she did. The only difference is that we swapped sides.
I know it's too late. But I still wish I'd found another way to stop her, instead of spreading those Scepters...
I kept my friends safe. Mirage even prospered from it. But that came at a price, and everyone else paid it.==W== I'm no different from you, Greyhorn. We're both trying to fix our mistakes.
... Sorry, let's focus.==W== We're completely understaffed right now. Got any tactical ideas?
I wouldn't worry about that. As luck would have it, your friends are already here.
Come on, ==PLAYER_NAME==, don't leave us hanging! You're going to settle this with Angie without us? How could you?
Noya?!==W== Iris and Amber are here too?==W== How did you find this place...?
Easy.==W== We pinpointed the city with the heaviest Scepter trafficking. Noya's gut feeling narrowed the search grid.==W== Amber scouted the rest.
You are the best...==W== But it's not just Angie today.==W== We're up against an entire mob packing Scepters of Death.
We figured.==W== We've been perfecting heavy-duty defensive spells for this exact moment. Even Scepter bullets won't get through.
It'll hurt. But we won't die.
Oh! I almost forgot!==W== We need a tiny favor from you.
You have to keep it a secret from Aunt Allie...==W== I mean, Mom... That we're fighting alongside you today. She cannot find out.
Hey, Allie?==W== I met up with Noya and the others. Don't worry, they're sticking to rear logistics.==W== They're perfectly safe out of harm's way.
Huh? Wait... What was that noise?==W== It sounded like a Scepter of Death firing...
Ah, no, definitely not!==W== We're in Cangwu. The new year is around the corner, those are Loong firecrackers!
Thank goodness...==W== Boss, could I ask you for a favor?
Of course. If it's something I can do, name it.
Thank you.==W== Please ...==W== bring those kids back to me safe and sound.
Boss,==W== they converted the inside of that house up ahead into a massive warehouse.==W== The Senators and Angie are holding their meeting inside.
Got it.==W== Here's the plan. Greyhorn, take your team and hit the front doors to draw their fire.==W== The New Star Guild and I will use the rooftops to flank them.==W==
Is everyone ready?==W== Let's move out!
Whoa, ==PLAYER_NAME==, you're way faster on your feet now!
My swordplay leveled up too. I practice that technique you taught me every single day. I'm up to a thousand swings a day now.
This trip was well worth the trouble. To think we'd finally gaze upon Lady Angie in the flesh.
I know, I was an absolute nervous wreck coming here. I thought that dreadful Boss or the Imperial Guard might track us down...==W== But attending this gathering was definitely the right move.
Besides, even if things go south, with Lady Angie running the show, what is there to worry about?
Watch your tongue, madam.==W== The Imperial Guard has recalled its forces. Commander Greyhorn is acting entirely on her own.==W==
Oh? Does the Imperial Guard want a cut of the Scepter trade too?
Hmph. We have zero interest in selling them.==W== We simply want one sample from every new batch to field test our bulletproof armor.
Do we have a deal, Lady Angie?==W== Agree to this, and the Imperial Guard will gladly make things convenient for everyone in this room...
Heh. Let's save the side deals for later. I called you all here to map out our direction for the coming year.
Ahem. First order of business.==W== To set up a proper front company for Scepter sales, we first need a Seal of Grace.
Heh! Now you're talking! I love a guy who gets straight to the point!
Going corporate means moving serious volume. Mr. Colston, can your people keep up with the Trekker supply?
Relax. I can drag in as many Trekkers as you need. Once the wishing wipes their memories, we'll dump them in the labor camps.
Hmph. With a monopoly on Scepters and the Guard's new armor, those peasants won't stand a chance. No more dirty sneak attacks from the rabble.
Once that happens, United Harvest HQ can raise a new army and take back control of United Harvest Philae.
I want to see Matilda on her knees, begging for my forgiveness!
Lady Angie, how are you allocating next quarter's supply?==W== The New Orelian faction can move ten thousand, no, twenty thousand units!
Unbelievable... Who is interrupting us at a time like this? Didn't I order to have this place locked down?
Sorry for the wait! Black Cat Pizza delivery here♪!==W== Your ten jumbo pineapple and sausage pizzas have arrived! Better eat up before they get cold!
Pizza? Heh! Hot pizza in this freezing weather? You guys sure know how to host a meeting!
Pineapple and sausage on a pizza?! Ugh, what kind of blasphemous abomination is this?!
Imperial Guard!==W== Hands on your heads and get on the ground! Nobody move!
You rely too much on those Scepters! Your backs are wide open!
Damn it, I can't pull it!
Boss, suspects secured.==W== But Angie seems off.
Angie hasn't said a word since the meeting started.
She's not Angie. She's just dressed up like her... And she's completely out of it?!
Heh...==W== Bwahahahaha!==W== You actually thought Angie was calling the shots? That she was the one running our Scepter trade?
You idiots. Brainless trash.==W== I figured out the Scepter's prayer myself! I've finally proven it!==W== My research is as good as anyone's!

As for the Angie you were waiting for, we did ask her to join.==W== But she insisted on investigating the Monoliths alone and vanished the day she broke out.==W== Heh. She's probably dead in some Monolith by now. So don't blame us for using her name.
You despicable scum...==W== Do human lives mean nothing to you?
Hehehe... Can you really afford to worry about others right now?
Boss. On the table. A phone. It's on a call.
Lady Gray. Does that name ring a bell, Boss?
You played well in Philae. I admit that.==W== But I only lost because Darcia let blind devotion cloud her judgment.
If she hadn't interfered, there wouldn't be enough of you left to bury.
The Scepter trade.==W== You've been running it this whole time?
Hah. Got it in one.==W== The New Orelian crew broke Angie out hoping she'd take the business. She turned her nose up at it.==W== So I stepped up.
Take a look around you, Boss.
Boss, these crates are packed with dark gray powder. It's the explosive from the Scepter rounds!
They rigged the main gates with explosive arrays. Every exit is completely sealed...==W== We walked right into a trap.
Lady Gray, your investors are still in here! Are you leaving them to die?
You can't spring a trap without bait.
